paper.title: Privileged Likelihood Is Not Automatically Value: Three Checks for Token Credit in On-Policy Self-Distillation
paper.abstract: Outcome verifiers score completed reasoning traces but do not assign credit to intermediate tokens. Privileged self-distillation attempts to fill this gap by rescoring a model's own rollout with training-only information. A token likelihood change, however, is not automatically outcome credit. We separate three questions: whether the score tracks better actions, whether feedback construction changes what is compared, and what behavior the training loss reinforces. We establish these distinctions

summary.core_problem: 特权自蒸馏用训练时可见信息对模型自身 rollout 重打分以做 token 级信用分配，但 token 似然变化并不自动等于结果信用。
summary.importance: 原理分析——形式化区分三个问题（分数是否追踪更好动作、反馈构造是否改变比较对象、损失强化什么行为），并实验验证加性分数接近随机。
summary.technical_approach: 形式化分析自依赖性：用同一 rollout 的事后反馈打分时，rollout 内容同时决定 token 和打分上下文，产生直接自依赖；用同问题另一 rollout 的反馈可消除依赖但不保证分数有用。在 20B 模型上做 AIME 2025 匹配实验。
summary.experiments: 20B 模型，AIME 2025；实现的加性分数 AUC=0.505（接近随机），长度调整后略微偏向错误轨迹。

summary_en.core_problem: Privileged self-distillation rescores a model's own rollouts with training-only information for token-level credit assignment, but a token likelihood change is not automatically outcome credit.
summary_en.importance: Principle analysis—formally separates three questions (whether the score tracks better actions, whether feedback construction changes what is compared, what behavior the loss reinforces) and empirically shows the additive score is near chance.
summary_en.technical_approach: Formal analysis of self-dependence: when a rollout is scored with hindsight feedback about that same rollout, its content determines both the tokens and the scoring context, creating direct self-dependence; using feedback from another rollout of the same problem removes dependence but does not guarantee a useful score. Matched experiments with a 20B model on AIME 2025.
summary_en.experiments: 20B model, AIME 2025; the implemented additive score has AUC=0.505 (near chance) and slightly favors incorrect traces after length adjustment.

recommendation.zh: 直接挑战特权自蒸馏做 token 信用分配的常见做法——加性分数接近随机，做 RL 训练的人应重新审视 hindsight 反馈的构造方式，重点看 §3 的形式化分解和 AIME 实验表。
recommendation.en: Directly challenges the common practice of privileged self-distillation for token credit assignment—the additive score is near chance; anyone doing RL training should revisit how hindsight feedback is constructed. Focus on §3's formal decomposition and the AIME experiment table.

paper.title: Search-G1: Grounded Search Agents via Representation-Based Intrinsic Rewards
paper.abstract: Search-augmented language agents should retrieve external information only when necessary and ground their answers in retrieved evidence. Existing external rewards provide either sparse outcome supervision or richer feedback from process annotations and LLM judges. Outcome rewards scale readily but cannot distinguish grounded retrieval from redundant search, whereas richer signals require costly annotation or inference during training. Internal rewards based on policy-side signals such as entrop

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作处理的是 search agent 训练里一个很具体但长期没有被好好刻画的问题：奖励函数无法区分“检索是必要的”与“检索只是多余动作”，也无法区分“答案真的依赖检索证据”与“模型本来就会，只是检索后顺手答对了”。只用 outcome reward，会把这几类轨迹都压成同一个正确标签；只用熵、置信度、信息增益这类内部信号，又更多是在测模型不确定性，而不是测证据 grounding。论文的目标，是在不依赖昂贵过程标注、也不调用外部 judge 的前提下，给 RL 训练提供一个低成本、细粒度、且随策略变化而更新的 grounded-search 奖励。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的直接关联不在“search agent 应用”本身，而在训练信号设计。它给出了一种值得注意的思路：把原本需要反事实干预才能得到的监督，先离线校准成轻量 readout，再在在线 RL 中摊销使用。这和 pretrain/post-train 交界处很多问题是相通的，比如如何把高成本监督蒸馏成可扩展训练信号，如何处理 policy drift 导致的 reward 失配，以及如何在 all-correct 但行为质量不同的样本上恢复 advantage 方差。贡献量级偏中等，更像是 reward engineering 与 adaptive measurement 的扎实推进，而不是新的基础范式。
summary.technical_approach:
方法核心有两个表示层 readout，都是用“策略相关的反事实干预”来做校准目标。第一个 readout 作用在 prompt state 上，预测 closed-book sufficiency，也就是当前策略在不检索时是否已经足够回答；其补量就是 retrieval necessity。第二个 readout 作用在 answer commitment 阶段，估计 evidence reliance：把已检索证据删除后，答案是否会变化，用这种 answer-stage sensitivity 作为 operational grounding 的代理。

关键点不在于直接在线做反事实，而在于先用干预构造标签，再训练轻量 readout 去近似这些判断。这样 rollout 时只需读取 policy representation，就能得到 necessity 和 reliance 分数，避免了过程标注和额外 LLM 调用。

奖励设计是 correctness-first 且 normalization-aware 的。正确的 searched trajectory，只有在 necessity 高时，reliance credit 才有意义；正确的 direct trajectory，则拿 closed-book sufficiency 的信用；重复搜索会有有界惩罚。这个设计针对 GRPO 一类 group-relative 更新里的一个实际问题：如果一个 group 里样本都答对，纯 outcome reward 会让 advantage 退化到接近 0，训练无法区分“少搜、必要搜、证据驱动搜”和“乱搜但也答对”。Search-G1 用 shaped reward 在这些 tied groups 里恢复了可学习差异。

另一个重要机制是 periodic refitting。因为 readout 依赖 policy representation，而 RL 会持续改变表示空间，所以 necessity/reliance 估计器如果固定不动，很快就会失准。论文把 search-agent 训练看成 measurement-credit-adaptation 的闭环：定期用最新策略生成轨迹，重新做校准并重训 readout，让奖励测量始终跟着 policy knowledge boundary 走。这一点比静态 reward model 更贴近实际训练动态。
summary.experiments:
实验覆盖四个 QA benchmark 和两个模型尺度，目标不是单纯追求最高准确率，而是看 grounding、search usage 和 accuracy 的平衡。文中在引言里给了几个能帮助理解设定的数字：在 held-out NQ 上，base Qwen2.5-3B 有 14% 的问题 closed-book 就能答对，说明“并非所有问题都需要 search”；HotpotQA 中 79.9% 是 bridge type，MuSiQue 全是 2 到 4 hop 问题，说明任务结构上确实存在较强证据依赖，但“任务需要多跳”不等于“当前策略一定需要检索”。

结果层面，Search-G1 在多个基准上都能提高 operational grounding，并缩短轨迹长度，同时保持有竞争力的任务准确率。论文还专门做了三类诊断：一是 estimator fidelity，检查 necessity/reliance readout 与真实干预标签的一致性；二是 reward tie-breaking，验证 shaped reward 是否真的在 all-correct groups 中恢复了 advantage 差异；三是 representation drift，说明如果不 refit，readout 会随着策略更新而退化。就全文给出的信息看，最有价值的不是某个单点分数，而是这些诊断把方法成立的链条补得比较完整。
summary.reading_guide:
这篇适合泛读，重点看三处。第一是 Introduction 和方法总图，先把两个判断分清：retrieval necessity 与 evidence reliance。很多 search-RL 工作把这两件事混在一起，这篇的价值就在于把它们拆开。第二是奖励函数定义和 normalization-aware credit assignment，尤其要看它如何处理 all-correct group 的零优势问题。第三是 periodic refitting 相关实验，看看 readout 漂移有多快、重拟合频率怎么选。

如果时间有限，优先看 Figure 1、Figure 2、方法节里两个 readout 的校准流程，以及实验里的 estimator fidelity / tie-breaking / drift 诊断。预计 25 到 40 分钟能抓住主要内容。若关心 RL for tool use 或 reward model 设计，可以再细看附录里各 benchmark 和轨迹构造细节。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets a specific failure mode in RL training for search agents: standard rewards cannot tell apart necessary retrieval from redundant retrieval, nor can they distinguish answers that truly depend on retrieved evidence from answers the model already knew and happened to retrieve before answering. Outcome-only rewards collapse these behaviors into the same “correct” label. Internal signals such as entropy, confidence, or information gain are cheap, but they mostly track uncertainty rather than grounding. The goal is to build a low-cost reward that measures policy-relative retrieval necessity and answer-level evidence reliance without process annotations or external LLM judges.
summary_en.importance: Its relevance to foundation-model research is mostly through training-signal design rather than search as an application. The useful idea is to turn expensive counterfactual supervision into amortized lightweight readouts that can be used during online RL. That pattern matters beyond search agents: scalable reward construction, reward-policy mismatch under policy drift, and restoring learning signal when all samples in a GRPO group are correct but behavior quality still differs. The contribution is solid and practical, though not a new modeling paradigm.
summary_en.technical_approach:
Search-G1 builds two representation-based readouts, both calibrated using policy-relative counterfactual interventions. The first readout operates on the prompt state and predicts closed-book sufficiency: whether the current policy could answer correctly without retrieval. Its complement is retrieval necessity. The second readout operates near answer commitment and estimates evidence reliance by measuring whether the answer would change if retrieved evidence were removed. This is framed as an operational proxy for grounding rather than a full causal certificate.

The key design choice is to use interventions for calibration, not for online reward computation. Counterfactual tests are run offline to create labels, and lightweight readouts are trained to predict those labels from the policy’s own representations. At rollout time, the reward can therefore be computed cheaply, without process supervision or extra model calls.

The trajectory reward is correctness-first and normalization-aware. Correct searched trajectories receive reliance credit only when retrieval was necessary. Correct direct-answer trajectories receive credit for closed-book sufficiency. Repeated search incurs a bounded penalty. This directly addresses a practical issue in group-relative RL such as GRPO: when all trajectories in a group are correct, pure outcome reward yields near-zero advantage and cannot separate efficient grounded search from redundant search. Search-G1 restores reward variation inside these tied groups.

A second important component is periodic refitting. Because the readouts depend on policy representations, and RL changes those representations over time, a frozen estimator will drift out of alignment. The paper treats training as a measurement-credit-adaptation loop: regenerate trajectories from the latest checkpoint, recalibrate the intervention targets, and refit the readouts so the reward remains aligned with the evolving policy boundary.
summary_en.experiments:
The evaluation spans four QA benchmarks and two model scales. The paper is not mainly about maximizing raw accuracy; it studies the trade-off among grounding, search usage, and task performance. A few setup numbers in the paper are already informative: on held-out NQ, a base Qwen2.5-3B answers 14% of questions correctly without retrieval, which means redundant search is a real issue; in HotpotQA, 79.9% of questions are bridge-type, and MuSiQue consists entirely of 2- to 4-hop questions, showing that evidence dependence is structurally common but still policy-relative.

Empirically, Search-G1 improves operational grounding and shortens trajectories while keeping accuracy competitive across benchmarks. The most useful part of the experimental section is the diagnostics. The paper checks estimator fidelity, asking whether the necessity and reliance readouts match the intervention-derived targets; reward tie-breaking, asking whether shaped rewards recover non-zero advantage in all-correct groups; and representation drift, showing that readout quality degrades without periodic refitting. The value is less in one headline metric and more in the fact that the paper closes the loop from measurement to credit assignment to adaptation.
summary_en.reading_guide:
This is a skim paper. Focus on three parts. First, read the introduction and the main method figure to separate retrieval necessity from evidence reliance; that distinction is the conceptual center of the work. Second, read the reward definition and the normalization-aware credit assignment, especially how it handles zero-advantage all-correct groups under GRPO-style updates. Third, read the periodic refitting experiments to understand how quickly the readouts drift and why static reward estimators are insufficient.

If time is limited, prioritize Figure 1, Figure 2, the calibration procedure for the two readouts, and the diagnostics on estimator fidelity, tie-breaking, and drift. Around 30 minutes should be enough to extract the main ideas. Read the appendix only if you care about benchmark-specific trajectory construction or implementation details.

recommendation.zh: 看 readout 校准实验；若干净成立，它比“让 judge 打分”更像可扩展的 agent RL 信号。
recommendation.en: Read the readout-calibration experiments; if clean, this is a more scalable agent-RL signal than asking a judge to score everything.

paper.title: EvoHarness-RL: Learning Self-Evolving Runtime Harness for Long-Horizon LLM Agents
paper.abstract: Long-horizon LLM agents increasingly rely on external execution support to maintain state, track progress, invoke tools, verify outcomes, and reuse experience across interactions. However, effective harness use raises two coupled challenges: state formation from noisy interaction traces and runtime control over external-state access. Existing agents usually handle both through prompts, heuristics, or domain-specific conventions, leaving the external workspace and its usage policy manually engine

summary.core_problem: 长程 Agent 往往依赖外部状态、工具、记忆和执行日志，但什么时候读、写、更新、压缩这些外部 harness，通常靠 prompt 或人工规则。论文要解决的是 harness policy learning：让模型学习运行时如何构造和使用外部状态，而不是只把 harness 当作固定脚手架。
summary.importance: 这篇工作不是基座预训练论文，和 LLM 训练的关系主要在 agent RL 和训练信号设计。它的启发在于把“外部状态使用”显式纳入策略学习，并对调用成本建模。对预训练研究的间接价值是：长程任务能力不只来自更长上下文或更多轨迹 SFT，也可能来自模型学会何时把状态外化、何时依赖内部策略、何时复用经验。这对 long-horizon agent post-training、工具使用 RL、记忆增强模型有参考意义。
summary.technical_approach: EvoHarness-RL 把复杂的外部执行支持抽象成 BPE workspace：Belief 表示当前环境状态，Progress 表示已完成和待完成子目标，Experience 表示跨 episode 可复用经验。Agent 通过紧凑的 harness meta-actions 与这些状态交互，例如查询 belief、提交 progress、召回 experience、写入新 insight。训练分两阶段。第一阶段是 supervised harness fine-tuning，让模型熟悉 BPE action protocol，并从交互轨迹中学习如何外化 belief、progress 和 experience。第二阶段使用 cost-aware GRPO，把 harness action 的成本纳入优化，因为读写外部状态会占用交互预算。奖励包含任务成功、效率、动作多样性、避免重复和动作格式合法性。方法的重点是把 harness 使用从 prompt-time 规则转成 learned runtime policy。
summary.experiments: 论文在 ALFWorld 上实例化 BPE：Belief 对应 world-state tracker，Progress 对应已提交的子目标计划，Experience 对应跨 episode skill bank。结果显示，仅在 prompt 中加入 BPE 已能改善有状态长程任务；经过 SFT 和 GRPO 后，ALFWorld seen split 成功率达到 96.9%，unseen split 达到 86.6%。分析部分提出两个现象。第一是 harness annealing：训练后模型减少频繁、脚手架式的外部调用，转向更选择性的状态访问，说明部分固定模式被内化进策略。第二是 harness evolution：在线 progress 更新和跨 episode experience consolidation 会把外部状态逐渐压缩成更适合当前任务族的支持结构。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，预计 20–30 分钟。重点看 Method 的 BPE 抽象和 action protocol，再看两阶段训练 recipe，尤其是 cost-aware GRPO 的奖励设计。实验部分关注 ALFWorld 适配方式、seen/unseen 成功率，以及 harness annealing 的调用频率变化。若只关心基座预训练，可以跳过环境细节，重点看外部状态如何被表示成可学习动作，以及成本约束如何改变 Agent 的运行时策略。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses harness policy learning for long-horizon LLM agents. Agents often rely on external state, tools, memories, trackers, and logs, but the policy for when to read, write, update, or consolidate this support is usually hand-designed through prompts or heuristics. EvoHarness-RL trains the model to coordinate with the harness at runtime.
summary_en.importance: This is not a base pretraining paper. Its relevance is mainly to agent post-training, RL for tool and memory use, and long-horizon execution. The useful idea is to make external-state access part of the learned policy and to price that access explicitly. For pretraining researchers, it suggests that long-horizon capability may depend not only on longer context or more trajectory imitation, but also on whether models learn when to externalize state, when to rely on internal computation, and when to reuse prior experience.
summary_en.technical_approach: EvoHarness-RL abstracts heterogeneous runtime support into a BPE workspace. Belief tracks the current environment state, Progress tracks completed and pending subgoals, and Experience stores reusable cross-episode knowledge. The agent interacts with this workspace through compact harness meta-actions, such as querying belief, committing progress, recalling experience, and writing new insights. Training has two stages. Supervised harness fine-tuning teaches the model the BPE action protocol and how to extract useful belief, progress, and experience from traces. Cost-aware GRPO then optimizes when to use the harness under an interaction budget. The reward includes task success, efficiency, action diversity, repetition avoidance, and valid action formatting. The main contribution is turning harness use from a prompt-time scaffold into a learned runtime control policy.
summary_en.experiments: The framework is instantiated in ALFWorld. In this environment, Belief is grounded as a world-state tracker, Progress as a committed subgoal plan, and Experience as a cross-episode skill bank for household tasks. Prompt-time BPE already improves stateful long-horizon execution. After SFT and GRPO, the reported success rate reaches 96.9% on the ALFWorld seen split and 86.6% on the unseen split. The analysis highlights two dynamics. Harness annealing means that training reduces frequent scaffold-like calls and shifts the agent toward selective external-state access. Harness evolution means that online progress updates and experience consolidation refine the external workspace into a more compact task-adaptive substrate.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in 20–30 minutes. Read the Method section for the BPE abstraction, the action protocol, and the two-stage training recipe. Pay particular attention to the cost-aware GRPO reward, because it determines whether the agent learns selective rather than excessive harness use. In the experiments, focus on the ALFWorld adapter, the seen and unseen success rates, and the analysis of harness annealing. Readers focused on base-model research can skip most environment details and concentrate on the representation of external state as learnable actions and the effect of cost constraints on runtime policy.

recommendation.zh: 用RL学习Agent运行时harness的思路新颖，cost-aware GRPO的设计对后训练RL优化有参考
recommendation.en: RL-learned agent runtime harness is novel; cost-aware GRPO design is relevant for post-training RL research.

paper.title: Contextual Information Policy Optimization for Search Agents
paper.abstract: Search agents extend large language models beyond static parametric memory by enabling them to acquire and use ex ternal evidence during multi-step reasoning. For knowledge intensive tasks involving complex or evolving information, their reliability depends not only on retrieving relevant ev idence but also on using it to guide subsequent reasoning. However, existing methods primarily reward final-answer cor rectness or intermediate progress, without directly assessing whether post-retrieval act

summary.core_problem: 现有强化学习方法训练搜索类agent时，奖励信号仅评估最终答案正确性或中间推理的收敛进度，没有直接约束检索后的推理步骤是否实质使用了新获取的检索证据，导致模型依赖参数内先验生成结论，检索行为仅用于确认已有假设，产生确认偏差、检索证据利用率低的问题。
summary.importance: 提出的无标注密集奖励构造思路，对工具增强类agent的后训练流程设计有参考价值，回应了检索增强系统中普遍存在的“检索但不使用”的训练信号错位问题，不需要额外训练奖励模型或补充人类标注，落地成本较低。
summary.technical_approach: 提出面向证据使用的强化学习框架CIPO。核心信号为证据访问对数似然比（EALR）：对每次检索后的推理步骤，固定全部前文上下文，分别计算模型在可见检索证据、掩码检索证据两种条件下生成当前动作的对数似然差值，直接量化当前推理对新检索内容的敏感度。该信号不需要额外奖励模型、人类标注或补充采样轨迹，可作为每步的密集奖励，与最终答案正确性的全局结果奖励结合进行策略优化，惩罚仅依赖内部先验、不使用检索证据的推理步骤。
summary.experiments: 在7个域内、域外知识密集型基准上测试，CIPO可显著降低先验驱动推理的比例，在多数任务上的表现优于现有的强化学习搜索agent基线。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读即可，重点关注EALR的奖励构造逻辑、以及验证确认偏差缓解效果的消融实验，理解“通过对比有/无外部信息条件下的生成似然差，量化模型对外部信息的实际使用程度”的核心设计，预计阅读时间15分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing RL methods for search agents only reward final answer correctness or intermediate trajectory progress, with no direct measurement of whether post-retrieval reasoning steps actually leverage newly fetched evidence. This reward misalignment causes agents to form conclusions from internal parametric priors, using retrieval only to confirm pre-existing hypotheses, leading to confirmation bias and low utilization of retrieved information.
summary_en.importance: The annotation-free dense reward design provides practical reference for post-training of tool-augmented LLMs, addressing the common 'retrieve but not use' failure mode in search agent systems. The signal requires no separate reward model, human labels, or additional rollouts, keeping implementation overhead low.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes Contextual Information Policy Optimization (CIPO), an evidence-oriented RL framework. Its core signal is the Evidence-Access Log-Likelihood Ratio (EALR): for each reasoning step after a retrieval call, all preceding trajectory context is held fixed, and the log-likelihood of the current action is computed under two conditions — with retrieved evidence visible, and with retrieved evidence masked. The difference between the two likelihoods directly quantifies how sensitive the current step is to the newly retrieved content. EALR serves as a per-step dense reward, combined with global outcome rewards for final answer correctness during policy optimization, to penalize steps that rely solely on internal priors without incorporating retrieved evidence.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated across 7 in-domain and out-of-domain knowledge-intensive benchmarks, CIPO substantially reduces the rate of prior-driven reasoning, and outperforms existing RL search agent baselines on most tasks.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim for the core reward design idea. Focus on the EALR formulation and ablations measuring confirmation bias reduction, to understand the principle of using likelihood contrast between information-present and information-masked conditions to quantify actual information usage. Estimated reading time: 15 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 密集证据奖励的设计对RLHF中事实性对齐有参考价值，重点看§3的信用分配定义。
recommendation.en: The dense evidence reward design is relevant for factual alignment in RLHF; focus on §3 for the credit assignment formulation.

paper.title: Qwen-CUA: Native Computer Use for (almost) Everything
paper.abstract: Native computer use offers a general interface for agents to operate almost any software available to people, but requires long-horizon state tracking, large-scale interactive experience, and learning from sparse yet verifiable outcomes. We introduce Qwen-CUA, a native computer-use agent with a 397B-A17B Qwen mixture-of-experts backbone. It observes only screenshots and acts through keyboard and mouse events, without DOM trees, accessibility metadata, or task-specific APIs. Its scaffold maintain

summary.core_problem: Qwen-CUA 解决的是原生计算机使用中的三个硬问题：只看截图、只发键鼠事件时，模型如何维持长程 GUI 状态；如何获得足够多、可验证、但成本很高的交互经验；如何用稀疏的最终结果奖励训练长轨迹多模态 agent。它刻意不使用 DOM、accessibility tree、shell 或任务 API，因此问题不再是网页自动化，而是把人类可见的像素界面作为统一行动接口来训练一个通用 agent。
summary.importance: 这项工作的价值主要在 agentic post-training 和多模态基础模型训练接口上，而不是单点算法。它把大规模可执行环境、可验证任务、长截图历史管理、稀疏奖励 RL、人工轨迹和迭代数据闭环放在同一个训练系统里。对预训练研究员有两个直接启发。第一，GUI 交互可以被组织成可规模化的多模态轨迹数据，成为模型能力继续扩展的训练来源。第二，final-state verifier 加 outcome reward 的训练方式，在真实软件环境里比静态 benchmark 更接近后续大模型能力扩展的形态，但它要求环境、任务状态和 rollout 吞吐先被工程化。
summary.technical_approach: 模型基座是 397B-A17B 的 Qwen MoE。输入只包含截图，输出是键盘和鼠标动作。为了处理长程任务，它保留最近 20 张活跃截图；更早的截图按 10 张一组折叠成固定大小块。这个设计的重点不是简单增加上下文，而是在保留近期视觉证据的同时，让 prompt prefix 尽量稳定，提升 KV-cache 复用，降低长轨迹推理成本。数据和环境侧，系统使用 Alibaba Cloud ECS rollout fleet，规模接近 100,000 vCPU，可同时运行数万环境。环境池覆盖可控 mock web services、日常桌面应用、长尾软件和专业软件。任务侧构造约 40,000 个可验证任务，包括环境操作、模拟用户交互，以及通过可验证 phase-state chaining 构造的长程 workflow。人工数据来自个性化桌面和专业软件轨迹，并加入 action-grounded step-level reasoning，用于补足纯环境采样难以覆盖的专家操作。训练侧使用 executable outcome rewards，并沿用 CUA-Gym 的可规模化环境与任务设计。RL 使用 Soft Adaptive Policy Optimization，目标是稳定长 reasoning-and-action 序列的更新。由于轨迹中包含大量图像历史，训练还使用 trajectory slicing，在切片训练时保留 episode-level reward 的归因。整体训练是迭代式的：当前模型暴露 SFT 未解决查询和弱领域，再驱动 teacher reroll、新人工轨迹、定向数据收集和 RL 任务校准。
summary.experiments: Qwen-CUA 在八个 computer-use benchmark 的任务指标上都超过 Qwen3.7。OSWorld-Verified 上，Qwen-CUA 得到 86.2，Qwen3.7 为 73.3，GPT-5.5 为 78.7，Claude Opus 4.8 为 83.4。OSWorld 2.0 的 binary / partial completion 从 Qwen3.7 的 2.5 / 22.5 提升到 18.5 / 48.4。把同一训练 recipe 扩到超过一万亿总参数的 Qwen-CUA-Max 后，OSWorld-Verified 进一步到 87.6，OSWorld 2.0 到 21.2 / 53.3。安全性上，RedTeamCUA attack success 相比 Qwen3.7 从 36.6 降到 16.4，同时任务成功率提升。效率分析显示，性能提升不能简单归因于更长或更啰嗦的 reasoning。内部 Chrome 部署展示了自然发生的浏览器任务，并对高影响动作加入用户确认。MyPCBench 实验说明，原生 GUI 操作与 Bash 结合可以显著缩短轨迹，这一点提示 native computer use 更适合作为通用视觉行动底座，而不是排斥专用工具。
summary.reading_guide: 建议精读 Agent Implementation、环境与任务构造、RL 训练和评测分析四块。Agent Implementation 里重点看截图历史的 20-active 加 block folding 设计，它直接对应长程多模态上下文的成本问题。环境与任务构造里重点看 40,000 可验证任务如何覆盖 mock 服务、桌面软件和专业工作流，以及 phase-state chaining 如何把长任务拆成可验证阶段。RL 部分重点看 SAPO、trajectory slicing 和 executable outcome reward 的组合，这些细节决定稀疏奖励是否能稳定作用到长轨迹。评测部分优先看 OSWorld-Verified、OSWorld 2.0、RedTeamCUA、reasoning length sweep 和 MyPCBench native-plus-Bash 结果。值得深挖的是：可验证 GUI 任务的设计方法、长视觉历史压缩与 KV-cache 复用的取舍、以及迭代式 SFT/RL 数据闭环如何定位模型弱点。
summary.authors_note: 阿里巴巴 Qwen 团队；给定内容未提供完整作者名单。

summary_en.core_problem: Qwen-CUA targets the hard version of computer use: an agent observes only screenshots and emits keyboard and mouse events, without DOM trees, accessibility metadata, shell access, or task APIs. Under this interface, the main challenges are long-horizon GUI state tracking, expensive interactive experience collection, and learning from sparse but executable outcome rewards.
summary_en.importance: The main contribution is a scaled training system for native computer-use agents. It is relevant to foundation-model training because it turns GUI interaction into large-scale multimodal trajectories with verifiable outcomes. The work also shows a practical interface between post-training and future pretraining-style data generation: environments expose failures, failures drive new SFT data and RL tasks, and the next model reruns the loop. The impact is less about a single new objective and more about making long-horizon, pixel-level agent experience trainable at scale.
summary_en.technical_approach: The model uses a 397B-A17B Qwen mixture-of-experts backbone. The observation is a screenshot, and the action space is native keyboard and mouse control. For long-horizon interaction, Qwen-CUA keeps 20 recent screenshots active and folds older screenshots into fixed-size blocks of ten. This preserves recent visual evidence while keeping the prompt prefix stable enough for KV-cache reuse. The rollout infrastructure runs on an Alibaba Cloud ECS fleet with access to nearly 100,000 vCPUs and tens of thousands of concurrent environments. The environment pool includes controllable mock web services, everyday desktop applications, long-tail applications, and professional software. The task set contains about 40,000 verifiable tasks covering environment operation, simulated-user interaction, and long workflows built through verifiable phase-state chaining. Human trajectories from personalized desktops and specialized software add supervision that pure synthetic environments would miss, with action-grounded step-level reasoning attached to the demonstrations. Training uses executable outcome rewards, the CUA-Gym environment design, Soft Adaptive Policy Optimization for stable updates over long reasoning-action sequences, and trajectory slicing to keep episode-level rewards usable when histories are image-heavy. The data loop is iterative: each trained model reveals unresolved SFT queries and weak domains, which then trigger teacher rerolls, new human trajectories, targeted data collection, and recalibrated RL tasks.
summary_en.experiments: Qwen-CUA improves over Qwen3.7 on all eight reported computer-use benchmarks. On OSWorld-Verified, it reaches 86.2, compared with 73.3 for Qwen3.7, 78.7 for GPT-5.5, and 83.4 for Claude Opus 4.8. On OSWorld 2.0, binary and partial completion improve from 2.5 and 22.5 to 18.5 and 48.4. Scaling the same recipe to the trillion-parameter Qwen-CUA-Max raises these numbers to 87.6 on OSWorld-Verified and 21.2 / 53.3 on OSWorld 2.0. RedTeamCUA attack success drops from 36.6 to 16.4 relative to Qwen3.7 while task success improves. Efficiency sweeps indicate that the gains are not just a result of more verbose reasoning. An internal Chrome deployment tests naturally occurring browser workflows with user confirmation for consequential actions. MyPCBench shows that combining native interaction with Bash can shorten trajectories substantially, suggesting that native computer use is best viewed as a general visual action interface that can be paired with specialized tools.
summary_en.reading_guide: Read the agent implementation, environment and task construction, RL training, and evaluation analysis in detail. The history-management design, especially the 20 active screenshots plus block folding, is the key systems idea for long multimodal contexts. The task-construction sections are important for understanding how verifiable GUI experience is scaled. The RL sections are worth reading for SAPO, trajectory slicing, and executable outcome rewards, because these are the mechanisms that make sparse final rewards usable. In the evaluation, focus on OSWorld-Verified, OSWorld 2.0, RedTeamCUA, reasoning-length sweeps, and the MyPCBench native-plus-Bash results. The most useful details to inspect are task verification, phase-state chaining, context compression, and the iterative data loop from model failures to new training data.
summary_en.authors_note: Alibaba Qwen team; the provided content does not include the full author list.

recommendation.zh: 必须读训练系统和 reward 章节；它改变的是 computer-use agent 的默认假设：别先要 DOM，先把可验证 rollout 规模做起来。
recommendation.en: Read the training-system and reward sections; it shifts the default assumption for computer-use agents from needing DOM access to scaling verifiable rollouts first.

paper.title: $β$-OPSD: Deriving with Policy Optimization, Training with Self-Distillation
paper.abstract: On-policy self-distillation (OPSD) is a promising approach to improve reasoning language models, but it remains brittle in practice: making it work reliably often requires substantial engineering effort. We identify a structural source of this difficulty: vanilla OPSD is precisely the $β=1$ member of a broader policy-optimization family, where $β$ weights the KL penalty anchoring the student to a reference policy. This equivalence turns $β$ from an implicit value fixed at one into a controllable

summary.core_problem: 论文处理的是 OPSD 在推理模型训练中不稳定的问题：直接让学生策略模仿带特权信息的教师策略，更新目标过硬，缺少对参考策略的显式约束强度控制。
summary.importance: 这篇更偏 post-train / reasoning self-improvement，但对预训练研究也有启发。它把自蒸馏重新写成 KL 正则化的策略优化问题，给出了一个可调的正则化旋钮 β。这个视角有助于理解为什么纯 imitation 式训练容易抖动，也提示在大规模训练中，教师信号、参考策略约束和训练稳定性需要一起设计，而不是只调学习率或采样温度。
summary.technical_approach: 核心做法是把 vanilla OPSD 解释为 β=1 的特例。β 控制学生策略贴近参考策略的程度；β 越大，目标越保守，越接近 reference policy；β=1 时退化为直接匹配 teacher。论文推导出 β-OPSD 的闭式最优策略，它是 reference policy 与 privileged teacher 的几何插值。直接做序列级 RL 会遇到 rollout 成本、高方差梯度和不可 tractable 的归一化项，所以作者只用 policy optimization 做目标推导，训练时仍回到 token-level distillation。实现上，用 scheduled logit interpolation 近似不同 β 下的目标分布，并引入 return-to-go credit assignment，把后续 token 的 student-target mismatch 回传给较早 token，缓解局部 token KL 更新过于短视的问题。
summary.experiments: 实验集中在数学推理 benchmark，使用 1.7B 到 8B 的开源 reasoning LMs。给出的关键数字是：在 Qwen3-1.7B 上，β-OPSD 相比 vanilla OPSD，在 AIME 2024、AIME 2025、HMMT 2025 的 avg@12 平均指标上最高提升 9.16 个百分点。消融结果支持两个组件都有贡献：一是 RL-derived interpolation target，比直接 teacher matching 更稳定；二是 return-to-go credit assignment 能改善序列级目标与 token 训练之间的错配。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读方法部分的两个推导：vanilla OPSD 如何等价于 β=1 的 KL-regularized policy optimization，以及最优策略为什么变成 reference 和 teacher 的几何插值。实验部分重点看 β schedule、logit interpolation、return-to-go 的消融。预计 25-35 分钟可以抓住主要信息。若关心大规模 reasoning post-train recipe，可进一步看训练稳定性曲线和不同模型尺寸上的一致性。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets a practical failure mode of OPSD for reasoning models: direct imitation of a privileged teacher gives the student a rigid target and offers no explicit control over how far the policy should move from a reference model.
summary_en.importance: The work is mainly about reasoning post-training, but the training signal analysis is relevant to foundation-model training. It reframes on-policy self-distillation as KL-regularized policy optimization and exposes β as a controllable regularization strength. This is useful because instability in self-improvement is often caused by the interaction between teacher quality, policy drift, and credit assignment, not only by optimizer settings.
summary_en.technical_approach: The main observation is that vanilla OPSD is the β=1 case of a broader policy-optimization family. β weights the KL anchor to a reference policy. Larger β gives a more conservative target closer to the reference policy; β=1 recovers direct teacher matching. The derived optimal policy is a geometric interpolation between the reference policy and the privileged teacher. Instead of directly optimizing the sequence-level RL objective, which would require expensive rollouts and high-variance estimation, the method uses the RL solution only to define the distillation target. In practice, the target is approximated through scheduled token-level logit interpolation. The paper also adds return-to-go credit assignment so that mismatch appearing later in a generated trajectory can affect updates to earlier tokens.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments use open-source reasoning models from 1.7B to 8B parameters on math reasoning benchmarks. The clearest reported result is on Qwen3-1.7B: β-OPSD improves avg@12 by up to 9.16 percentage points over vanilla OPSD across AIME 2024, AIME 2025, and HMMT 2025. Ablations indicate that both the interpolated RL-derived target and return-to-go credit assignment contribute to the gains and to better optimization stability.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim the derivation connecting vanilla OPSD to the β=1 KL-regularized objective, then read the closed-form interpolation target and the return-to-go section more carefully. The most useful experimental parts are the β schedule, logit-interpolation ablations, and stability comparisons. A focused read should take about 25-35 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 把OPSD从经验trick提升到策略优化统一视角，β插值的闭式解可直接复用到内部RL与自蒸馏混合训练ablation，重点看§3推导。
recommendation.en: Lifts OPSD from an empirical trick to a unified policy-optimization view; the closed-form β interpolation can be directly reused in internal RL+self-distillation ablations, focus on §3 derivations.

paper.title: MIRROR: Learning from the Other View for Multi-Modal Reasoning
paper.abstract: Unlike large language models (LLMs) that exhibit strong reasoning capabilities, vision-language models (VLMs) struggle with visual reasoning, even on geometry problems that admit equivalent text, diagram, and combined diagram+text views. We show that these views often elicit different behaviors: a model may solve a problem from text but fail on the corresponding diagram, or succeed visually while failing textually. This inconsistency suggests that different views expose complementary reasoning p

summary.core_problem: 多模态推理模型在同一道几何题的不同视图（纯文本、纯图像、图文结合）上表现不一致：模型可能在一种视图下解出，在另一种视图下失败。论文研究这种跨视图不一致是否能作为自监督信号，用来提升弱视图下的推理能力。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的直接启发有限，但对多模态 post-training 有参考价值：它展示了一种不依赖外部教师的自蒸馏思路——用同一问题下模型自身的强视图作为教师，通过 on-policy 重打分把推理能力迁移到弱视图。这种“同一问题、不同视图互为监督”的思想，对多模态统一预训练中如何设计跨模态一致性 loss 也有间接启发。
summary.technical_approach: 构建 ODA-Data：同一几何题的 text-dominant、image-dominant、combined 三种视图配对数据集。训练框架 MIRROR：对每道题，先用当前模型在三种视图下分别 rollout，选 pass 率最高的视图作为该题的教师视图；学生在受限视图（纯文本或纯图像）下采样自己的轨迹，教师视图只对学生生成的同一条轨迹做重打分（不强制学生模仿教师视角下才可见的推理路径），再结合学生视图下的 outcome-reward RL 做优化。关键设计是 on-policy distillation：学生在自己的视图下采样，教师只提供相对排序信号，避免了跨视图信息泄漏。
summary.experiments: 基座模型 Qwen3-VL-4B-Instruct。在 ODA-Val 上，MIRROR 相对基座 image pass@16 +14.49%、text pass@16 +5.88%；外部迁移 GeoInt pass@16 +7.59%，MathVerse mean judge score +5.22%。跨视图一致性（同一题在 image 和 text 视图下都解出的比例）从 42.5% 提升到 60.7%，净可解题目数 +8.95%。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读即可，建议 15–20 分钟。重点看 §1 中关于跨视图不一致的现象刻画（Table 1）、§3 的 MIRROR 训练框架图（Figure 1）以及 on-policy 重打分与标准蒸馏的区别。对预训练研究者而言，最值得带走的是“同一语义不同视图互为教师”这个自监督思路，而不是几何任务本身。

summary_en.core_problem: Vision-language models show inconsistent reasoning across views of the same geometry problem: a model may solve the text-only form but fail on the diagram-only form, or vice versa. The paper asks whether this cross-view inconsistency can be exploited as a self-supervision signal to improve the weaker view.
summary_en.importance: The direct relevance to pretraining is limited, but the idea is useful for multimodal post-training and, indirectly, for cross-modal consistency objectives in unified pretraining: the model's own stronger view on a given problem serves as a teacher for the weaker view, without relying on external teachers or curated rationales.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors build ODA-Data, a paired geometry dataset with text-dominant, image-dominant, and combined views of the same problems. MIRROR evaluates the current model on all three views per problem and selects the strongest view as a problem-specific teacher. The student samples rollouts under a restricted view (text-only or image-only); the teacher only rescores the student's own trajectories (on-policy distillation), avoiding trajectories that depend on information unavailable to the student. This rescoring is combined with outcome-reward RL under the student's own view.
summary_en.experiments: Base model: Qwen3-VL-4B-Instruct. On ODA-Val, MIRROR improves image pass@16 by 14.49% and text pass@16 by 5.88% over the base model. Transfer: GeoInt pass@16 +7.59%, MathVerse mean judge score +5.22%. Cross-view consistency (fraction of problems solved under both image and text views) rises from 42.5% to 60.7%; net solvability gain on ODA-Data is +8.95%.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim, ~15–20 minutes. Focus on the cross-view inconsistency characterization in §1 (Table 1), the MIRROR framework in §3 (Figure 1), and the distinction between on-policy rescoring and standard distillation. The main takeaway for pretrain researchers is the self-supervision pattern—different views of the same semantics acting as mutual teachers—rather than the geometry task itself.

recommendation.zh: ‘同一问题多视图不一致’这个观察比方法更值钱；做 VLM 后训练的人看 ODA-Data 构造和 reward 设计即可，别期待通用结论。
recommendation.en: The cross-view inconsistency observation is worth more than the method; if you do VLM post-training, look at ODA-Data construction and reward design, but don't expect general conclusions.

paper.title: OpenForgeRL: Train Harness-native Agents in Any Environment
paper.abstract: Modern AI agents rely on elaborate inference harnesses such as Claude Code, Codex, and OpenClaw to drive multi-turn reasoning, tool use, and access to external systems. While powerful, these complex harnesses also make agents hard to train end-to-end with open infrastructure, whose SFT/RL stacks cannot natively express stateful, multi-process harness inference. To address this, we present OpenForgeRL, an open-source framework for training harness-based agents end-to-end in diverse environments.

summary.core_problem: 现代 agent 依赖复杂的有状态、多进程推理 harness（Claude Code、Codex 等），而开源 SFT/RL 栈无法原生表达这类 harness 推理，导致端到端训练困难。
summary.importance: 系统/工程贡献：开源框架，解耦 harness 推理与 RL 训练，使任意 harness + 任意环境下的端到端 agent 训练可规模化。
summary.technical_approach: OpenForgeRL：轻量代理拦截 harness 的模型调用并记录为标准 RL 代码库（如 veRL）的训练数据；Kubernetes 编排器在独立远程容器中运行每次 rollout，从而在任意 harness/环境上大规模训练。
summary.experiments: abstract 未给出具体模型规模、环境或数值结果，定位为框架发布。
summary.authors_note: Jianfeng Gao 团队（微软），Baolin Peng、Zhou Yu 等在 agent/对话方向有长期工作。

summary_en.core_problem: Modern AI agents rely on stateful, multi-process inference harnesses (Claude Code, Codex, OpenClaw) that open SFT/RL stacks cannot natively express, making end-to-end training hard.
summary_en.importance: Systems/engineering contribution: an open-source framework decoupling harness inference from RL training to enable end-to-end agent training at scale across arbitrary harnesses and environments.
summary_en.technical_approach: OpenForgeRL uses a lightweight proxy serving the harness's model calls while recording them as training data for a standard RL codebase (e.g., veRL), plus a Kubernetes orchestrator running each rollout in its own remote container.
summary_en.experiments: No model sizes, environments, or numbers in the abstract; positioned as a framework release.

recommendation.zh: 框架类工作，核心价值是把 harness-native agent 接进 veRL 类 RL 栈；做 agent RL 训练的人看架构图即可，预训练侧无直接 insight。
recommendation.en: Infrastructure work that wires harness-native agents into veRL-style RL stacks; useful if you train agents at scale, but no direct pretraining insight—skim the architecture diagram.

paper.title: From Trajectories to Prefixes: Reusing Teacher Trajectories via Replayed Prefixes and Online Continuation
paper.abstract: Small language models are attractive backbones for interactive agents, but direct distillation from strong teacher trajectories often turns rich multi-turn behavior into one-shot imitation targets. This is inefficient in long-horizon environments, where early decisions shape later states and rewards. We propose Prefix-GRPO, a reinforcement learning framework that decomposes teacher trajectories into replay-aligned prefix queries and online continuations. Each prefix is replayed in the environmen

summary.core_problem: 解决小语言模型做交互式 agent 时，直接模仿强 teacher 的完整轨迹会把多轮行为压成单次响应监督，无法有效学习长程决策的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是面向 agent 后训练的 RL 方法。它把 teacher trajectory 的 replay、prefix learning 和在线 continuation 统一到同一个 policy optimization 框架里，对如何把强模型轨迹转成可学习训练信号有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Prefix-GRPO。方法把 teacher trajectory 切成 replay-aligned prefix query，在环境中重放 prefix 以恢复合法中间状态，然后让 student 从该状态继续在线交互并接收任务奖励。不同于只更新当前 response 的 GRPO，它还对 replayed prefix 中历史 assistant tokens 做 clipped policy update，并用 policy-distilled SFT checkpoint 估计 old log-probability。
summary.experiments: 在 TextCraft、BabyAI 和 ALFWorld 等长程交互环境上评估。摘要称 Prefix-GRPO 优于 response-only GRPO 和直接轨迹蒸馏类设置，但未给出 student/teacher 模型规模、任务成功率提升和训练 token/episode 成本。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses the mismatch between rich teacher trajectories and one-shot imitation targets when training small language-model agents for long-horizon interaction.
summary_en.importance: This is a post-training RL method for agents. Its useful part is the conversion of teacher trajectories into replayable prefixes plus online continuations, which is relevant to building higher-quality training signals from strong-model behavior.
summary_en.technical_approach: Prefix-GRPO decomposes teacher trajectories into replay-aligned prefix queries. Each prefix is replayed in the environment to recover a valid intermediate state, after which the student continues interaction online and receives task reward. Unlike response-only GRPO, it also applies clipped policy updates to historical assistant tokens in the replayed prefix, using a policy-distilled SFT checkpoint to estimate old log-probabilities.
summary_en.experiments: The method is evaluated on TextCraft, BabyAI, and ALFWorld. The abstract reports gains over response-only GRPO and trajectory imitation-style baselines, but does not provide student/teacher scale, success-rate deltas, or episode-level training cost.

recommendation.zh: 读方法和 ablation；trajectory replay 这条线比结果数字更有用，可借来做长程 RL 数据再利用。
recommendation.en: Read the method and ablations; the trajectory-replay formulation is more useful than the reported scores and may transfer to long-horizon RL data reuse.

paper.title: QUADS: Stabilizing NVFP4 Reinforcement Learning for MoE via QUantization-error Alignment across Dual Sides
paper.abstract: Rollout generation is a major bottleneck in Reinforcement Learning (RL) for Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) Large Language Models, motivating low-precision rollout acceleration such as FP8. As an emerging low-precision format, NVFP4 combines fine-grained scaling for accuracy preservation with native W4A4 FP4 GEMMs for higher throughput than FP8. However, we find that directly applying NVFP4 to MoE RL rollout is impractical. NVFP4 rollout with BF16 training collapses after roughly 150 steps, accompanied

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作解决的是一个很具体的工程—算法接口问题：在 MoE 大模型的 RL 训练里，rollout 端如果用 Blackwell 上原生 W4A4 的 NVFP4 来提速，会因为 rollout 与 trainer 的 log-probability 偏差迅速放大而训练崩溃。作者要找出的不是“低精度会不会掉点”这种泛泛结论，而是：崩溃主要来自权重量化还是激活量化；如果主要来自激活误差，那么在 rollout 和 trainer 分离的 RL 管线里，怎样做误差对齐，才能既保住 W4A4 吞吐，又不破坏 GRPO 的策略梯度稳定性。
summary.importance: 它对预训练本身不是直接贡献，但对 pretrain↔posttrain 接口、训练稳定性和低精度系统设计很有参考价值。原因有两点。第一，RL 训练越来越像一个分布式异构系统问题，rollout 精度不只是 serving 细节，而是直接进入 importance ratio 和 policy update 的训练信号。第二，这篇工作把“低精度不稳定”拆成了可操作的误差来源分析，指出在 NVFP4 这种极低比特格式下，激活误差比权重误差更致命，而两者不能用同一种对齐策略处理。这个结论对未来更激进的低精度 pretrain / mid-train 也有启发：如果训练和推理路径不一致，先分清哪些张量可同步、哪些张量是在线重算的，往往比统一做 fake quant 更关键。贡献量级属于强工程方法论文，尤其适合关注 RL 系统、MoE 和 Blackwell 低精度栈的人。
summary.technical_approach: 作者的方法叫 QUADS，核心是 dual-side quantization-error alignment，也就是 trainer 侧和 rollout 侧分别处理不同来源的误差，而不是试图用一个统一的量化方案覆盖全部路径。诊断部分先做了关键 ablation：把 rollout 中的权重和激活分开量化，比较 W4A16 与 W16A4。结果显示 W16A4 的失败模式几乎贴近完整 W4A4，而 W4A16 明显更稳定，说明 activation quantization 才是主导项，且权重误差与激活误差近似可加。基于这个发现，QUADS 分两部分。其一是 trainer-side asymmetric QAT：在训练端只对权重做 NVFP4 fake quantization / dequantization，对激活保持 BF16。这样做的原因很直接：权重在 rollout engine 与 trainer 之间是同步参数，可以共享匹配的 QDQ 路径；而激活是每次 rollout 在线重算的，若在 trainer 端也强行做对称 W4A4 fake quant，反而会把本来无法严格对齐的激活误差注入学习过程。其二是 rollout-side residual activation compensation：既然激活误差是主因，就在真正的 W4A4 rollout 里对高残差通道做 second-pass quantization，用额外一轮更精细的补偿减少 activation quantization 带来的 log-prob 偏差。作者强调这部分通过 fused kernels 实现，目的是保住大部分原生 W4A4 Tensor Core 吞吐优势，而不是退回高精度 GEMM。与已有方法相比，QeRL 之类只做 weight-only NVFP4，激活仍用 BF16，本质上没有进入真正的 W4A4 regime；FP8/INT8 RL 系统则处在更宽松的数值网格上，训练—推理不匹配更容易靠 clipping 或 TIS 控住。QUADS 的区别在于它正面处理 full-parameter MoE GRPO 下的原生 FP4 activation mismatch。
summary.experiments: 实验结论很清楚。首先，naive NVFP4 W4A4 rollout + BF16 training 会在大约 150 个 RL step 后崩溃，表现为 reward 和 held-out score 同时下降，且 rollout–trainer 的 per-token log-probability gap 单调增大，importance ratio 被推离 trust region。其次，分离量化的 ablation 证明了误差来源：W16A4 基本复现 W4A4 的不稳定，而 W4A16 更接近稳定训练，支持“激活误差主导”的判断。最终结果上，QUADS 在 full-parameter MoE GRPO 中把平均 pass@1 做到 72.86%，几乎追平 BF16 baseline 的 73.15%，远高于 naive NVFP4 的 51.37%。同时，rollout throughput 比 FP8 还高 16%。摘要里提到评测覆盖四个 held-out benchmarks，但给出的全文片段没有展开具体 benchmark 名称、模型规模、专家数、训练 token 数和 group size G 等更细节数字；这些应在实验节和附录里核对。就目前可见信息，最重要的不是绝对分数，而是三组对比关系：BF16≈QUADS >> naive NVFP4，以及 QUADS 在稳定性恢复后仍保留对 FP8 的吞吐优势。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议很明确。先看 Introduction 里对 RL pipeline 的问题定义，确认作者讨论的是 decoupled rollout/trainer 架构下的数值偏差，而不是普通量化推理。然后直接看 Section 3.1 的 ablation，这是全文最关键的一页：如果不先接受“activation error 是主因”，后面的 asymmetric QAT 和 residual compensation 就会显得像两块经验 patch。接着看 trainer-side QAT 和 rollout-side compensation 的实现细节，重点关注为什么一边只量化权重、另一边专门补偿激活，以及 fused kernel 是否真的保住吞吐。最后看主结果表，核对三件事：训练是否稳定到全程、log-prob gap 是否被压回可控范围、吞吐提升是否在端到端而不只是 kernel 级。预计阅读时间 20-30 分钟。若要深挖，建议追问两个问题：一是这种方法对 dense model 是否同样成立，还是 MoE 的路由稀疏性放大了激活误差；二是 residual activation compensation 的额外开销在更长 CoT rollout 下是否仍然划算。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses a specific systems-and-optimization problem in RL for MoE LLMs: native NVFP4 W4A4 rollout on Blackwell is attractive for throughput, but when rollout is run in FP4 while training remains in BF16, the rollout–trainer log-probability mismatch quickly destabilizes GRPO and causes collapse. The key question is not simply whether low precision hurts, but which source of error matters most—weights or activations—and how to align quantization error across the decoupled rollout and trainer paths without giving up the throughput advantage of true W4A4 execution.
summary_en.importance: This is not a pretraining paper in the narrow sense, but it is highly relevant to the pretrain–posttrain interface, training stability, and low-precision system design. Two points matter. First, in modern RL pipelines, rollout precision is part of the training signal because token log-probabilities feed directly into importance ratios and policy updates; it is not just a serving detail. Second, the paper turns “low precision instability” into a structured error-analysis problem and shows that under NVFP4, activation quantization is much more damaging than weight quantization, and the two should not be handled with the same alignment strategy. That lesson generalizes: whenever training and inference paths diverge, it is often more important to distinguish synchronized tensors from online-recomputed tensors than to apply a uniform fake-quant recipe everywhere. The contribution is best seen as a strong engineering method paper for RL systems, MoE training, and Blackwell-era low-precision deployment.
summary_en.technical_approach: The method, QUADS, stands for quantization-error alignment across dual sides. The central idea is to treat trainer-side and rollout-side errors differently instead of forcing a single quantization scheme over both. The diagnostic step is crucial: the authors separately quantize weights and activations during rollout and compare W4A16 against W16A4. W16A4 closely reproduces the failure mode of full W4A4, while W4A16 is much more stable, showing that activation quantization dominates the instability and that weight and activation errors are roughly additive. Based on this, QUADS has two components. First, trainer-side asymmetric QAT: weights are fake-quantized to NVFP4, but activations remain in BF16. The rationale is that weights are synchronized across rollout and trainer engines, so their quantization–dequantization path can be aligned; activations are recomputed online during rollout and cannot be faithfully matched by symmetric W4A4 fake quantization on the learner side. Second, rollout-side residual activation compensation: since activation error is the main problem, the rollout engine performs a second-pass quantization on high-residual channels to reduce activation-induced log-prob bias while preserving native W4A4 GEMMs. The implementation uses fused kernels so that most of the throughput benefit of FP4 Tensor Cores is retained. This differs from prior work in an important way. Weight-only NVFP4 methods such as QeRL never enter the true W4A4 regime because activations stay in BF16, and FP8/INT8 RL systems operate on a much denser numerical grid where mismatch can often be controlled by clipping or truncated importance sampling. QUADS is designed specifically for full-parameter MoE GRPO with native FP4 activation quantization.
summary_en.experiments: The empirical story is straightforward. Naive NVFP4 rollout with W4A4 inference and BF16 training collapses after roughly 150 RL steps: reward and held-out performance drop, while the per-token rollout–trainer log-probability gap grows monotonically and pushes importance ratios outside the trust region. The weight-vs-activation ablation then identifies the source: W16A4 largely matches the instability of full W4A4, whereas W4A16 remains much closer to stable behavior, supporting the claim that activation error is the dominant driver. In the final results, QUADS reaches 72.86% average pass@1 across four held-out benchmarks, essentially matching the BF16 baseline at 73.15% and far outperforming naive NVFP4 at 51.37%. At the same time, it improves rollout throughput by 16% over FP8. The provided text does not expose finer details such as model size, expert count, benchmark names, total RL steps, or exact GRPO group settings, so those should be checked in the experimental section and appendix. The main takeaway is the relation among the three systems: BF16 ≈ QUADS >> naive NVFP4, with QUADS still preserving a throughput edge over FP8.
summary_en.reading_guide: For a skim, start with the introduction to anchor the problem correctly: this is about numerical mismatch in a decoupled rollout/trainer RL pipeline, not generic quantized inference. Then go directly to the ablation in Section 3.1. That is the most important part of the paper. If the activation-dominant failure mode is not established first, the later design choices can look like ad hoc patches. After that, read the trainer-side asymmetric QAT and rollout-side residual compensation sections, focusing on why one side aligns weights while the other explicitly compensates activations, and whether the fused-kernel implementation really preserves throughput. Finally, inspect the main result tables for three things: end-to-end training stability, reduction of the rollout–trainer log-prob gap, and whether the throughput gain survives beyond kernel-level microbenchmarks. A useful skim should take 20–30 minutes. If you want to go deeper, two questions are worth pursuing: whether the same conclusion holds for dense models or is amplified by MoE routing sparsity, and whether the extra cost of residual activation compensation remains favorable for longer chain-of-thought rollouts.

recommendation.zh: 这篇该看的是“激活误差比权重误差更致命”这个结论；若你在做低精度 RL 或 rollout-serving 一体化，先复现 log-prob gap 诊断再谈提速。
recommendation.en: The key takeaway is that activation error, not weight error, dominates FP4 RL collapse; if you run low-precision RL or rollout-serving stacks, reproduce the log-prob-gap diagnostic before chasing throughput.

paper.title: Understanding Reasoning from Pretraining to Post-Training
paper.abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) has become central to improving large language models (LLMs) on complex reasoning tasks, yet RL post-training is largely studied in isolation from the pretraining that precedes it. As a result, two basic questions remain open: (1) how do pretraining choices (model size, data) shape the returns to RL compute, and (2) what does RL actually do to the model? These questions are difficult to study in the standard LLM setting: pretraining corpora are vast and uncontrolled,

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文要回答一个预训练研究里很实际的问题：给定总计算量，应该把多少算力花在做更强的 pretrained prior，多少算力留给后续 RL。作者没有把 RL post-training 当成孤立阶段，而是研究预训练规模、预训练数据质量、RL compute 三者如何共同决定推理性能。自然语言 LLM 上很难做这种实验，因为语料不可控、训练成本高、评估只看最终答案。论文用国际象棋构造了一个可控替代环境，用人类棋谱预训练、合成 reasoning traces 做 SFT，再用可验证奖励做 RL，从而观察从 pretraining 到 post-training 的完整链条。
summary.importance: 价值在于把“预训练损失”和“RL 后性能”放进同一个定量框架。结论不是简单地说 RL 只是激发已有能力，或者 RL 能从零发现新能力，而是给出一个更细的图景：预训练越强，RL 的收益曲线也会变化；预训练 loss 能预测 RL 后的 pass@1；局部 RL slope 近似随 log pretraining token count 线性增长。对基座研究员来说，最有用的是它把 compute allocation 从经验判断推进到可拟合的 scaling-law 问题。它的量级还不是 frontier LLM 级别，任务也是 chess，但实验设计干净，能提供一套研究 pretrain-posttrain 闭环的模板。
summary.technical_approach: 方法分三层。第一层是受控训练管线：模型先在 tokenized human games 上做预训练，数据量和数据质量可以通过棋谱数量、玩家 Elo 等变量控制；然后在 synthetic reasoning traces 上做 SFT，使模型具备可用于 RL 初始化的推理轨迹格式；最后用 verifiable reward 做 RL。这个设置对应 LLM 的 base model、SFT model、RL-tuned model，但比自然语言更容易归因。第二层是联合 scaling law。作者先拟合 Chinchilla 风格的预训练 loss scaling，建模参数量 N、预训练 token 数 T 与 loss 的关系；再观察 RL 阶段中 downstream pass@1 的提升斜率如何随预训练条件变化。关键发现是 post-RL 性能可以由 pretraining loss 提供强预测信号，而局部 RL 改善率与 log T 近似线性相关。这样就可以对由 N、T、RL compute 组成的训练 recipe 打分，并画出 compute-optimal frontier。第三层是机制分析。作者不只看最终解题正确率，而是检查单步 move policy 的变化。结果显示，在简单 puzzle 上，RL 更多是在放大 SFT policy 已经偏好的正确 move；在困难 puzzle 上，RL 有时能把原先概率很低但正确的 move 推上来。这解释了为什么“RL 只是 sharpening”和“RL 能组合新能力”两种说法都会在不同难度区间出现。
summary.experiments: 核心实验覆盖 5M 到 1B 参数模型，并扫了 36 组 pretraining-RL 组合。评估指标包括 pass@1，以及围绕 policy evolution 的逐步行为分析。主要结果有三点。第一，预训练 loss 对 RL 后下游性能有预测力，说明 base prior 的质量不是只影响 RL 初始点，也影响后续 RL 的可扩展性。第二，RL 的局部收益斜率随 log pretraining token count 近似线性增长，这意味着更大的预训练数据不只是降低初始 loss，也会改变后续 RL compute 的边际回报。第三，把该关系和预训练 scaling law 结合后，作者得到一条 compute-optimal frontier：随着总计算量增加，最优 recipe 中分配给 RL 的比例会上升。机制实验进一步区分了 easy 和 hard puzzles：easy case 中 RL 更像选择性放大；hard case 中 RL 可能使先前不显著的正确动作浮现。论文还用一个 1B math-domain language model 做迁移检验，说明这种 pretraining-to-RL interaction 不完全局限于 chess，但外推到通用语言推理仍需要谨慎。
summary.reading_guide: 建议精读训练设置、联合 scaling law 和机制分析三部分。Section 2 要看清楚 chess 如何映射到 LLM 训练流程：预训练语料怎么构造，SFT traces 怎么生成，RL reward 怎么定义，哪些变量被控制住。Section 3 是核心，重点看 pretraining loss 如何预测 post-RL pass@1、RL local slope 如何拟合、以及 compute-optimal frontier 的推导。图表上优先看 Fig. 1 的整体管线，以及所有展示 pretraining tokens、model size、RL compute 与 pass@1 关系的曲线。机制部分值得细读 easy/hard puzzle 的分层分析，尤其是 RL 对 move probability distribution 的改变。深挖时要关注两个限制：chess 的 action space 和 reward 比自然语言更规整；SFT 初始化质量可能强烈影响 RL 被观察到的行为。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies a practical allocation problem in reasoning model training: under a fixed compute budget, how much compute should be spent on improving the pretrained prior, and how much should be reserved for RL. Instead of treating RL post-training as an isolated stage, it asks how model size, pretraining data, and RL compute interact. The authors use chess as a controlled proxy for the full LLM pipeline: pretraining on human games, SFT on synthetic reasoning traces, and RL with verifiable rewards. This avoids several confounders in natural-language LLMs, where pretraining data is heterogeneous, systematic sweeps are expensive, and final-answer metrics hide step-level policy behavior.
summary_en.importance: The main contribution is a quantitative bridge between pretraining scaling and RL scaling. The paper shows that pretraining loss is predictive of downstream pass@1 after RL, and that the local slope of RL improvement grows approximately linearly with the logarithm of the number of pretraining tokens. For pretraining researchers, this is useful because it reframes post-training returns as something partially determined by the base model’s scaling regime, not merely by the RL recipe. The work is not a direct frontier-LLM scaling law, and chess is a simplified environment, but the experimental control is unusually clean. It provides a concrete template for studying the pretrain-to-posttrain loop.
summary_en.technical_approach: The approach has three parts. First, the authors build a controlled training pipeline that mirrors standard LLM training. Models are pretrained on tokenized human chess games, with data amount and quality controlled through corpus choices such as player Elo filtering. They are then supervised-finetuned on synthetic reasoning traces and optimized with RL using verifiable rewards. Second, they fit a joint pretraining-RL scaling picture. A Chinchilla-style pretraining loss law relates parameter count N and token count T to pretraining loss. The RL stage is then modeled through downstream pass@1 and local RL improvement slopes under different pretraining conditions. The key empirical relation is that stronger pretraining predicts stronger post-RL performance, while the local RL slope scales roughly with log T. This allows hypothetical recipes over N, T, and RL compute to be scored and compared. Third, the paper inspects policy changes at the move level. On easy puzzles, RL mostly increases the probability of correct moves already preferred by the SFT policy. On harder puzzles, it can surface correct moves that were initially assigned low probability. This explains why sharpening and discovery-like behavior can both appear, depending on problem difficulty.
summary_en.experiments: The main sweep covers models from 5M to 1B parameters and 36 pretraining-RL combinations. The central metric is pass@1 after RL, supplemented by policy-level analysis over individual moves. The main empirical findings are: pretraining loss predicts post-RL downstream performance; the local RL improvement slope grows approximately linearly with log pretraining token count; combining this relation with a pretraining loss scaling law yields a compute-optimal frontier where the optimal fraction of compute allocated to RL increases as total compute grows. The mechanism experiments separate easy and hard puzzles. In easy cases, RL behaves mostly like probability sharpening over moves already favored by the SFT model. In hard cases, RL can promote correct moves that were not initially prominent. The authors also test the pattern beyond chess using a 1B language model trained on math-domain text, suggesting that the interaction is not purely a chess artifact, although broad transfer to general LLM reasoning remains an open question.
summary_en.reading_guide: Read the training setup and the scaling-law section carefully. The setup section explains why chess gives unusually fine control over pretraining data, reward verification, and step-level policy analysis. The scaling section is the core: focus on how pretraining loss is connected to post-RL pass@1, how the RL local slope is measured, and how N, T, and RL compute are combined into a recipe score. The most important plots are the pipeline figure, the pretraining/RL sweep curves, and the compute-optimal frontier. The mechanism section is also worth close reading, especially the easy-versus-hard puzzle split and the move-probability analyses. The main caveats to keep in mind are the compact action space, the clean reward signal, and the dependence on the SFT initialization.

recommendation.zh: 应把这个 chess setup 当低成本 pretrain↔RL 消融模板复现；外推到自然语言前先检查 reward 与数据分布差异。
recommendation.en: Use the chess setup as a low-cost template for pretrain-to-RL ablations; before extrapolating to language, check the reward and data-distribution mismatch.

paper.title: Self-Review Reinforcement Learning (SRRL) with Cross-Episode Memory and Policy Distillation
paper.abstract: Reinforcement Learning is commonly used to train large language models using environmental feedback. In applied settings, the environment usually provides sparse or delayed feedback. This makes it difficult for the model to pinpoint which actions in its reasoning led to success or failure. So, learning effectively from these signals is hard because the model must determine how each failure should inform meaningful behavioral corrections in subsequent iterations. We introduce a training framework

summary.core_problem: 稀疏/延迟环境反馈下，RL 训练 LLM 难以定位推理链中哪一步导致失败，推理时反思方法又无法把改进内化进 base policy。
summary.importance: 提出把显式 self-review 步骤嵌入每个 RL episode，失败后生成 self-review 再二次尝试，并用策略梯度 + 跨回合记忆 + 选择性蒸馏把反思能力内化到策略，而不是仅停留在 test-time reflection。
summary.technical_approach: SRRL：首轮回答失败后让模型生成 self-review 诊断错误，据此做二次尝试；self-review 本身通过 policy gradient 优化；用 cross-episode memory 复用历史经验，通过 selective policy distillation 将改进持久化进 base policy，区别于 Reflexion 等 inference-time reflection。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体模型规模、数据集或量化增益，方法框架性描述为主。

summary_en.core_problem: Under sparse or delayed environmental feedback, RL-trained LLMs cannot easily attribute failures to specific reasoning steps, while inference-time reflection methods (e.g., Reflexion) fail to internalize improvements into the base policy.
summary_en.importance: Proposes embedding an explicit self-review step inside each RL episode: after a failed first attempt the model generates a self-review and retries; policy gradients on self-review plus cross-episode memory and selective distillation internalize reflection into the policy rather than leaving it at test time.
summary_en.technical_approach: SRRL inserts a self-review phase after failures, conditions a second attempt on the review, trains the self-review head with policy gradients, maintains a cross-episode memory, and distills successful behavior into the base policy via selective distillation—distinct from inference-time reflection such as Reflexion.
summary_en.experiments: No concrete model sizes, datasets, or quantitative gains in the abstract; mainly a framework-level proposal.

recommendation.zh: 把 Reflexion 搬进 RL 并用蒸馏固化，思路自然但缺实验；关心 RLVR 训练动态的人扫一眼框架图即可。
recommendation.en: Reflexion folded into RL with distillation to bake it in—a natural idea but experiments are missing; if you care about RLVR training dynamics just skim the framework figure.

paper.title: MentalThink: Shaping Thoughts in Mental SVG World
